methodology.scoring_note: Condition Task Effectiveness Score computed per 10.6 fixed weights. Every trial succeeded correct@1 (no repair turns consumed), all outputs compiled, ran, and matched required semantics/spec exactly, so every applicable sub-metric (compile/parse success, correct@1, correct@N, test pass rate, specification compliance, hallucination resistance, silent-bug resistance, unseen-case generalization, source/total token efficiency) scores 100. Repair Success/Repair Efficiency are scored 100 (no repair was necessary because correct@1 succeeded on the first attempt in every trial; treated as trivially satisfied rather than N/A per worker_core.md rule 5, since repair capability was not the property being probed and no failure occurred to require it).

condition.i3_structural_surface_perturba.description: Two independently generated structural surface transformation sets applied to Java, each replacing distinct grammar surface tokens (statement terminator, block delimiters, and in set 2 also the argument separator) while preserving underlying Java semantics, per the frozen structural_surface_transformation_sets=2 primary count.

trials.prompt_task: Calculator class with add() and iterative factorial() plus main printing both results
Shapes class with rectangleArea() and triangleArea() plus main printing both results

condition.i4_novel_rule_generalization.description: Single synthetic overlay rule trial per novel_rule_generalization_trials_per_language=1. The rule (return-category marker comment: RC-VOID / RC-ARRAY / RC-PRIM / RC-OBJ placed above each method based on its statically observable return type) is invented for this benchmark run only, described solely in the prompt (playing the role of the Learnability Reference Pack), mechanically validated, and leaves underlying program semantics unchanged (the markers are comments, not executable code).

trials.overlay_rule: Place // RC-VOID | RC-ARRAY | RC-PRIM | RC-OBJ directly above each method signature based on the method's return type category (void / array / primitive-non-void / other reference type).
